claim: A recorder that returns 0xFF on port FE makes a game that compares whole port values ignore every key, with no warning; use an Issue 3 style recorder and check that scripted keys visibly move the player.

evidence.text: record returned 0xFF on port FE and the game ignored every key; recordings made with an Issue 3 rule fixed it. JNext gives bit 6 = 0 and both builds move; a real Next's EAR input is unchecked.
